items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: And you're on the record; the people on the record are ... Juan Tizol ... and Wendell Marshall ... I played it last night. Do you remember that? ... He was another nice bass player, too.

ctx.x: I remember in the band bus-- how I'd ridden, different it was from the times before when I read, that when Louie was there, he and Wendell used to ride in the back of the bus with a radio playing classical music, and I never heard classical music on the band bus before that. But Louie was so interested in so many kinds of music.
Well, Juan introduced Louie and Pearl.
